pr.title: Add cancellation reasons
pr.author: bob
pr.head: feature/cancel-reasons
pr.body:
Lets customers and operators say why an order was cancelled.

- `POST /orders/{id}/events` accepts an optional `reason` with the `cancel` event.
- `order.CancelWithReason` cancels and records the reason on the order.
- The reason is stored as the `detail` of the cancel row in `order_events`.

No migration needed.

comments.author: carol
comments.body: Can we cap the length of `reason`? Right now a client can send a megabyte of text and we'll write all of it into order_events. Something like 200 characters, rejected with a 422, would be plenty.

comments.author: alice
comments.body: Should `reason` be an enum (customer_request, out_of_stock, fraud, ...) instead of free text? The storefront could show a picker, and reporting would be much easier.

comments.author: bob
comments.body: Good question, I'm not sure ops has a fixed list yet. Let's discuss.

comments.author: carol
comments.body: If this cancels a paid order, does the customer get refunded automatically, or does someone have to do that by hand? I can't see anything here that triggers a refund.
